description: This file defines the backend storage interface and implementation for etcd, including database management, snapshotting, defragmentation, and transaction handling using BoltDB.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Interface for backend storage operations including transactions, snapshotting, defragmentation, and size management.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Interface representing a database snapshot with methods for size, writing, and closing.

classes.name: txReadBufferCache
classes.description: Cache structure for read transaction buffers to optimize concurrent access.

classes.name: backend
classes.description: Implementation of the Backend interface, managing BoltDB database, transactions, and defragmentation.

classes.name: snapshot
classes.description: Implementation of the Snapshot interface, wrapping a BoltDB transaction for snapshot purposes.

classes.name: zapBoltLogger
classes.description: Adapter for BoltDB logger using zap SugaredLogger.

methods.name: BatchTx
methods.description: Returns the current batch transaction for batched operations.

methods.name: SetTxPostLockInsideApplyHook
methods.description: Sets a hook function to be called after locking a transaction inside apply.

methods.name: ConcurrentReadTx
methods.description: Creates and returns a new non-blocking read transaction with cached buffer.

methods.name: ForceCommit
methods.description: Forces the current batch transaction to commit.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current database state.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash of the database contents, optionally ignoring certain buckets or keys.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the physically allocated size of the backend database.

methods.name: SizeInUse
methods.description: Returns the logically used size of the backend database.

methods.name: Defrag
methods.description: Performs database defragmentation to optimize storage.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the backend database and releases resources.
